decided_by: Codex (agent; user-authorized SPOT consolidation and contract modeling)
rationale: Consolidate source-name privacy and cross-package symbol decisions at their canonical owners. Add native Contract 3.8 max_file_lines with a hard 500-line ceiling for maintained sources, tests and tools, complete snapshot-bound inventory and exact hash-bound upstream/generated exclusions; no oversized-source allowance. Declare the immutable repository-file DTO owner, exact reader/evaluator ports and optional snapshot signatures required by this capability. Preserve component directions and all coupling ceilings. Keep the already tightened calls_unresolved ceiling 838 and every other baseline budget unchanged; existing oversized files remain violations, not accepted baseline entries.
